-- Spec: return the longer of the two lists; the first wins a tie.
longest(take a: List[int], take b: List[int]) -> List[int] =
  post out.len() >= 0
  ex longest([1, 2, 3], [4, 5]) == [1, 2, 3]
  ex longest([1], [2, 3]) == [2, 3]
  ex longest([7], [8]) == [7]
  if a.len() >= b.len()
    return a
  b

test_longest() =
  assert longest([1, 2, 3], [4, 5]) == [1, 2, 3]
  assert longest([1], [2, 3]) == [2, 3]
  assert longest([7], [8]) == [7]
